Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. Program fee: $2,250 (includes housing, most meals, tours, transportation, and entrance fees) *Airfare not included. 
Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu)

Did you think about being an RA, but didn't get around to applying?

Then you are in luck because we are accepting applications for positions in Gaass, Graham, and TMK. If you are interested in applying, please contact Jaycee Redlinger (smithja@central.edu) for more information.

Range Day 2026

Central History Club presents Range Day 2026! Join us Tuesday, April 21st, from 0930-1500 (9:30 AM to 3:00 PM) at the Marion County Sheriff’s Office Shooting Range to interact with various historical firearms! This event is free. Drive yourself or carpool for transport. Come and go as you please. All are welcome to participate. 
Address: 1950 Marion County Hwy T17, Bussey, IA 50044 

Questions? Contact venemal1@central.edu or dircksk1@central.edu for information.

Benefit Bash this Saturday!

Get ready for an unforgettable night at Benefit Bash this Saturday, April 18, from 7–10 p.m. at the Pella Opera House! 

If you haven’t grabbed your ticket yet, there’s still time—stop by the Student Development Office to purchase yours for just $10. 

This year’s event features a masquerade theme, and masks will be provided—just bring your energy and enjoy the mystery! Snacks will be available, along with a cash bar for guests 21+. 

Don’t miss out—we can’t wait to see you there!

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 4/19/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu
